name: Egyptian Arabic Tutor
summary: A daily Egyptian Arabic reading text and vocabulary flashcard trainer, with Greek and Chinese translations.
description: Egyptian Arabic Tutor shows a short Egyptian-Arabic reading passage (with Greek and Chinese translations) and a swipeable vocabulary flashcard deck on Sticky's e-ink screen. New content can be synced daily over WiFi from a URL you host (see the project README for the companion content-generation pipeline), or loaded manually onto the SD card. No account or cloud service from this project is required to use it offline with manually-loaded content.

compatibility.notes: NOT YET VERIFIED on physical hardware. The e-ink (SSD1677) and touch (GT911) drivers are an integration step against community reference drivers — see README_DRIVERS.md. Remove this note once physical-device testing (per the Playground contribution checklist) is complete.

assets.previewAlt: Egyptian Arabic Tutor home screen mockup on reTerminal Sticky, showing the Home/Read/Train menu bar

notes.title: Driver integration required before first build
notes.description: hal_display.cpp, hal_touch.cpp and hal_buzzer.cpp must be filled in from a verified community driver before this compiles — see README_DRIVERS.md. This is not yet done in this submission.

notes.title: Set WiFi and content URL before flashing
notes.description: Edit WIFI_SSID, WIFI_PASSWORD and CONTENT_MANIFEST_URL in source/src/config.h. Without a reachable content URL, load a day package onto the SD card manually instead.
